title: Gimbal radar returns as interference or echoes of a distant jet

tellings.quote: Perhaps there was a distant jet and the the radar got messed up and it made it appear as you someone actually told me that as a possibility.

plain: The radar readings tied to the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy infrared clip from off the US East Coast of an object that seems to rotate, could have come from interference or from echoes of a distant jet, not a strange craft. Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, says on the show that someone told him this as a possibility: "Perhaps there was a distant jet and the radar got messed up." If so, the radar would not back up the pilots' reading of the object.
